items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: And I got old Louis and Johnny St. Cyr and Yudell Wilson.

ctx.x: Yes. He played the piano. Oh man, and how. And so that's when I got Louis, to come over to the Orchard. And that was just the next night, we had to open at the Orchard. And I got old Louis and Johnny St. Cyr and Yudell Wilson. And we opened up. And boy oh boy, that knocked Bootsy out. Because Bootsy was a Manuel Perez fan. He just loved Manuel Perez. But old Bootsy Hernendez boy, he loved Louis.
Well now, this is roughly when?
